text:
olivia: quick follow-up from todays all-hands: kernel/runtime leads - can we list the ship timeline, the defaults we'll document (batching/caching), and the fallback plan? docs/product need short copy.

james: Kernel lead here. Timeline: alpha->staging in 5 days, 2 week staging soak, small prod canary at ~2.5 weeks, full rollout if green by week 5. Branch kernel/fastpath, commit d4e5f6.

sofia: Docs: will there be behavior changes customers should expect?

james: Mostly perf/memory wins. Expect tiny FP diffs from quant paths; no intentional behavior changes. Call out q8 risks for long contexts.

kai: Default runtime config we should ship? ops wants exact fields.

james: Proposed defaults:
```yaml
batching.max_batch_size: 56
batching.max_wait_ms: 20
batching.dynamic: true
cache.prefix_kv: true
cache.ttl_ms: 90000
kernel.use_opt: true
```
These bias for latency while getting most batching benefit.

ravi: Quantization guidance?

james: Recommend q4f for most models; q8 experimental for >8k contexts and only after validation. We'll run curated evals during canary.

noah: Observability: we'll emit tags: kernel.variant, cache.hit, batch.size. Tracing sampling 10% hosted by default, 0% for Dedicated unless enabled. Note: trace volume +6-9%.

olivia: Rollback triggers? what auto actions exist if canary regresses?

james: Automated rollback if regression_alert_rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency > baseline*1.2 for > 5m. Hosted will flip image to previous variant; Dedicated ops runbook provided.

deploy-bot: Canary started service=gen cluster=prod-us at ts=1834300022 (image: registry.redwood/kernel-fastpath:d4e5f6)

sofia: Action items: (1) docs "what changed" + migration snippets (sofia), (2) add customer prompt sets to canary evals (ravi), (3) sampling config + metric docs (noah), (4) canary runbook + rollback playbook (james). I'll assemble release note.

james: :thumbsup:

sofia: :thumbsup: adding to backlog RW-2199.

ravi: :thumbsup: pulling customer prompts now.

noah: :thumbsup: adjusting observability templates.

olivia: thanks all — i'll coordinate product comms and publish the brief.
